stem: On an IBM QPU, how many shots does each twirling randomization of this PUB run?
code:
sampler = SamplerV2(mode=backend)
sampler.options.default_shots = 4096
sampler.options.twirling.enable_gates = True
sampler.options.twirling.num_randomizations = 8
# shots_per_randomization is left at "auto"

job = sampler.run([isa], shots=1000)

explanation.correct: Two rules interact. First, shot precedence: `run(shots=1000)` is part of the primitive interface and is always obeyed, so `default_shots = 4096` plays no role. Second, the twirling allocation: when `num_randomizations` is fixed and `shots_per_randomization` is "auto", the latter is set to `ceil(shots / num_randomizations)` = `ceil(1000 / 8)` = 125, so 8 randomizations x 125 shots cover the requested 1000.

distractors.A: Precedence misconception: `default_shots` is the lowest-priority source; a `run()` shot count overrides it, so 4096 / 8 is never computed.
distractors.B: Wrong auto branch: `max(64, ceil(shots / 32))` is used only when BOTH twirling counts are "auto". With `num_randomizations` fixed at 8, the shots are divided by 8.
distractors.C: Total read as per-randomization: the 1000 requested shots are spread across the 8 randomizations, not repeated for each one.
distractors.D: Default count assumed: dividing by 32 treats the randomization count as some built-in 32, ignoring the explicit `num_randomizations = 8`.

provenance.notes: R2 add, conceptual: twirling auto shots_per_randomization = ceil(shots/num_randomizations) when num_randomizations is fixed (TwirlingOptions 0.48 API page) + run() shots outrank default_shots (guides/sampler-options precedence list). Server-side allocation, not observable in local mode.
